metadata.note: Hosted console HITL create route. Body is actionName plus payloadSummary. Bearer token {{var.organization.spurvikApiKey}}. Make's custom-variables page (https://help.make.com/custom-variables) says organization custom variables are only on Pro, Teams, and Enterprise, and that values are plain text, not for secrets. If that plan is unavailable, use a scenario input spurvikApiKey mapped as {{var.input.spurvikApiKey}} (https://help.make.com/use-scenario-inputs does not state a plan requirement). This blueprint has not been test-imported in Make. Do not map the API key from the webhook payload.
